summary.name: Moodle (Moodle Development GitHub org)
summary.one_liner: The GitHub organization page for Moodle Development, hosting the open source Moodle learning platform source code and related repositories such as developer docs and API documentation builds.
use_cases: Downloading the Moodle learning platform source code
Browsing Moodle PHP and JavaScript API docs
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitHub organization for Moodle Development, listing 16 public repositories. The main repository, moodle, is the Moodle open source learning platform written in PHP and licensed GPL-3.0. Other repositories include devdocs (source for Moodle Developer Resources), phpdoc and jsdoc (API documentation builds), composer-installer and moodle-composer-scaffold (Composer support), seed (a starter for a Moodle site), and moodlenet (an archived MoodleNet project under AGPL-3.0). The page lists the organization's top languages as PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript and Shell.
notable: Main moodle repository is GPL-3.0 licensed with about 7.6k stars
Includes developer documentation and API doc build repositories
Composer installer and scaffold repositories for Moodle
caveats: The moodlenet repository is marked as an archive
